items.title: Patient experience and engagement during acute non-invasive ventilation
items.summary: Aim: To explore patients’ experiences of acute non-invasive ventilation (NIV) and examine the role of patient engagement in treatment acceptance and tolerance. Methods: A descriptive qualitative design was employed using semistructured interviews with five patients who had recently received acute NIV.
